title: One common starting state.
text: Nominal 500 km SSO. Twelve 4 kg 3U payloads. Generic host: 500 kg wet bus, including 20 kg fuel once; Isp 220 s.

title: Twelve scheduled releases.
text: Actual computed Gen5 host history, uniform-2 target family. Markers identify the frozen release epochs; the inertial X/Z projection preserves the numerical trajectory.
evidence_class: Computed host trajectory / fixed-axis J2 / X–Z projection

title: Host manoeuvre. Point. Release.
text: Host burns provide the departure state and direction. The launcher adds the coupled release contribution. The propagated state depends on both.
evidence_class: Conceptual operations diagram / generic host study

title: Frozen full-state targets.
text: Uniform synthetic 2 m/s or alternating 1/3 m/s along-track target families. All payloads and retained host are compared at t = 91800 s: 24 h after the final release.
evidence_class: Computed target states / synthetic study cases

title: Coast for loading and safe release.
text: Gen5 reserves 400 s of zero-force loading coast per payload for the declared 355 s cycle. Both architectures keep 5 s pre-release and 20 s post-release zero-force guards.
evidence_class: Source-derived operation timing / one 450 s release leg

title: Command flexibility and installed cost.
text: The ideal ground-pretrimmed spring closes both target families at the 1 N and 5 N gates. Preplanned targets give no established Gen5 propellant or initial wet-mass advantage.

title: Independent replay of target states.
text: Native Orekit 13.1.6 replay and 60→30 s refinement agree within the declared numerical residuals. Numerical agreement is not physical delivery accuracy.
evidence_class: Computed numerical agreement / native Orekit replay

title: Mission model and applicability.
text: Fixed-axis J2 point masses and constant inertial force. Drag, higher gravity, attitude/plume allocation, navigation and finite exit geometry are outside this study.
evidence_class: Generic host study / modeled target states

title: Twelve releases. One resource account.
text: Twelve commanded releases share one coupled resource account: payloads, retained device, host burns, source energy and carrier recovery. Inspect the frozen target states and same-input policies.
evidence_class: Computed result / synthetic preplanned target families
